$comment: Traceability: ADR-PROJ023-001 (Hybrid B+C), Phase 5 Red-Blue Composition (D3FEND Gap Envelope, blue-d3fend -> red-lead), Phase 5 Handoff Protocols. Data sanitization rules: ATT&CK ID regex ^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$, D3FEND ID regex ^D3-[A-Z]{2,5}$. Security control T-04: DGE includes d3fend_kb_version for staleness tracking.
title: D3FEND Gap Envelope (DGE) v1
description: Cross-skill data contract for blue-team to red-team D3FEND coverage gap analysis. Informs red-lead of defensive coverage gaps so future engagements can be scoped to test undefended areas. Source: blue-d3fend. Destination: red-lead. Blue-to-Red direction: analysis-derived content. Red-lead MUST verify D3FEND KB version currency before incorporating gaps into future engagement scope.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the engagement or exercise this gap analysis relates to.

from_skill.description: Originating skill. Always /blue-team for DGE envelopes.

to_skill.description: Destination skill. Always /red-team for DGE envelopes.

from_agent.description: Blue-team agent that produced this gap analysis. Always blue-d3fend for DGE envelopes.

to_agent.description: Red-team agent that receives this envelope for engagement scoping. Always red-lead for DGE envelopes.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-technique coverage gap entries prioritized for red-lead engagement scoping. An empty array indicates no coverage gaps were identified (full D3FEND coverage achieved).

technique_id.description: ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID. Validated against ATT&CK format.

d3fend_countermeasure_expected.description: D3FEND countermeasure ID that should provide coverage for this technique per the D3FEND knowledge base. Validated against D3FEND ID format.

d3fend_tactic.description: D3FEND tactic for the expected countermeasure.

gap_type.description: Gap classification. no_rule: no detection rule exists for this technique. partial_rule: rule exists but coverage is incomplete (some detection domains missing). untested: rule exists but validation requires deployed Tier C infrastructure not yet available.

priority.description: Gap priority for red-lead scoping decisions. high: recommend for next engagement RoE technique allowlist. medium: recommend for capability development roadmap. informational: track for maturity roadmap.

recommended_action.description: Specific recommendation for red-lead on how to incorporate this gap into future engagement scoping. Maximum 2000 characters.
examples: Include in RoE to test detection capability -- no detection coverage exists
Deploy Tier C Suricata infrastructure for verification of existing rule
Upgrade tool tier from B to A for full verification of partial coverage

scoping_relevance.description: Consumer-facing action classification for red-lead. Derived from priority: high=include-in-roe, medium=develop-capability, informational=track-for-roadmap.

current_coverage_status.description: Current detection coverage classification from the purple team exercise.

tool_tier_required.description: Minimum tool tier required to close this gap. Tier C gaps require user-deployed infrastructure beyond Jerry framework tools.

blocking_tools.description: Specific tools that must be deployed to close a Tier C gap.

d3fend_kb_version.description: D3FEND knowledge base version used for countermeasure gap analysis. Required per security control T-04: red-lead MUST verify D3FEND version currency before incorporating gaps into engagement scope to prevent stale gap recommendations.

analysis_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this gap analysis was performed. Used together with d3fend_kb_version for staleness detection.

gap_summary.description: Aggregate gap statistics for quick orientation without reading per-technique detail.

total_techniques_analyzed.description: Total number of techniques in the gap analysis.

no_rule_gaps.description: Count of techniques with gap_type = 'no_rule' (highest urgency for rule generation).

tier_c_blocked_gaps.description: Count of techniques with gap_type = 'untested' (blocked on Tier C infrastructure deployment).

d3fend_verified_count.description: Count of techniques with Verified D3FEND coverage (not included in coverage_gaps array).

trust_classification.description: Trust boundary classification for this blue-to-red envelope.

source_skill.description: Originating skill. Always /blue-team for DGE envelopes.

target_skill.description: Destination skill. Always /red-team for DGE envelopes.

source_zone.description: Security zone. Blue-team is universally Zone 1 (Analysis).

taint_level.description: Blue-to-red D3FEND gap analysis is analysis-derived -- it represents mapping and gap findings, not adversary-modeled behavior.

validation_required.description: Validation steps for red-lead when receiving this envelope.
default: D3FEND technique IDs validated against current D3FEND knowledge base
Coverage confidence reflects actual tool tier, not aspirational
D3FEND KB version verified for currency before incorporating gaps into engagement scope

data_classification.description: Sensitivity classification for this gap envelope.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol marking. DGE envelopes are typically TLP:GREEN (coverage gaps are non-sensitive analytical findings).

contains_credentials.description: D3FEND gap analysis does not contain credential material. Always false for DGE per design.

engagement_scope_id.description: Reference to the governing engagement scope document.

retention_policy.description: DGE envelopes have project-scoped retention by default: gap analysis is valuable for scoping future engagements beyond the current exercise.

source_artifact.description: Path to the D3FEND coverage matrix from which this DGE was constructed. Relative to work/.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this envelope was created.

purple_iteration.description: Purple team loop iteration this gap analysis relates to.
